# Phase Two — Gevurah Architecture

The Awtsmoos is beyond all accounting, while finite commerce needs strict Gevurah: no credit moves without evidence that value may be delivered.

## Paid Action State Machine
- quote: identify product, capability, units and cost without mutation.
- reserve: atomically hold credits under an idempotency key when asynchronous work begins.
- execute: provider or deterministic product work happens outside the wallet lock.
- commit: reserved credits become consumed only after success testimony.
- release: failed/cancelled work restores the reservation exactly once.

## Boundaries
- Wallet owns balances/reservations/ledger only.
- Product service owns provider execution and success testimony.
- Browser owns intention and display, never price or ledger authority.
- Analytics receive event metadata, never private user content.
- Existing direct consume remains valid for deterministic immediate actions.

## First Adoption Candidates
- Transcribe hosted mode only after server-side provider gateway exists; user-key mode stays free and uncharged.
- Deterministic export/download/template/cosmetic operations can use direct consume after successful local/server generation.
- Games use credits for cosmetics/content/convenience, never competitive power.
